title: A dependency graph file, graphs/<name>.json
description: The dependency graph, keyed by gated item, then by the status it is blocked from entering (graphs.md, "Dependency asset" and "Predicate entries", D-606; F-148 D2). Each status holds a list of entries, each an object of one item id to one CEL expression over that item's record. Whether the expression compiles is the engine's check, not the schema's.

additionalProperties.description: One gated item: status to its list of entries.

items.description: One entry: one item id to one CEL expression.
